scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @fabricante/web" "npm run start:dev --workspace @fabricante/api"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @fabricante/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @fabricante/api
